text:
Could be improved. ARE THEY REALLY ALUM. Stay tuned. But for now> they can pop off shower rod since no ball (or curve or "nub") at end of hook (My last set had it)
Update = 6 mos later: End one has rust on it - the one we touch to open/close...I cant tell if its from rod so replacing rod. Rod does have rust along it.

product_metadata.title: Zenna Home NeverRust Rustproof Aluminum Shower Hooks, with Decorative Ball, Set of 12, Matte Black
features: GUARANTEED FOR LIFE NEVERRUST TECHNOLOGY: Aluminum shower curtain hooks are durable, lightweight and guaranteed for life not to rust
EASY TO INSTALL ON ANY STANDARD SHOWER ROD: Hooked shape easily attaches to a standard-sized shower rod and moves with ease
DECORATIVE AND FUNCTIONAL HOOKS: Ball-shaped end adds a decorative touch and helps keep curtain or liner secure on your shower rod
STYLISH MATTE BLACK FINISH: Matte black finish will complement your bath décor and hardware choices
SET OF 12 HOOKS: Matches number of holes on standard shower curtains and liners
RUSTPROOF YOUR ENTIRE BATH: Combine with any Zenna Home NeverRust shower rod for a rustproof shower solution
description: The Zenna Home NeverRust Rustproof Aluminum Shower Hooks give you a decorative and rustproof way to keep your shower curtain or liner in place on any shower rod. Strong and lightweight aluminum construction makes these hooks guaranteed for life against rust. Each hook has a stylish ball-shaped end that keeps your curtain or liner from falling off. The hooks have a sleek matte black finish to complement your bath decor, and there are 12 in each pack to match the number of holes on any standard shower curtain or liner.
